artifactCheck.evidence: git status --short returned no staged or unstaged generated SQLite databases, credentials, secrets, audio, or PDFs before writing this QA report.

userSpecAcceptanceCriteria.criterion: Only role = captain sees and starts captain actions.
userSpecAcceptanceCriteria.evidence: app/bot/menus.py::build_role_menu includes captain-only actions only for role captain; tests/test_participant_messages.py::test_captain_menu_contains_participant_and_captain_actions; tests/test_captain_team_flow.py::test_non_captain_cannot_view_team.
tests/test_captain_team_flow.py::test_captain_can_view_only_own_team asserts own-team names are visible and other-team names/IDs are absent.

userSpecAcceptanceCriteria.criterion: Captain cannot select another team's participant through forged callback/ID.
userSpecAcceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_captain_boundaries.py::test_forged_other_team_participant_id_is_rejected; CaptainService reloads target participant by id and compares target team_id to captain team_id.

userSpecAcceptanceCriteria.criterion: Captain cannot submit manual report for dropped participant.
Captain cannot submit duplicate weekly report for participant/week.
Captain cannot save status-changing manual report after Sunday 23:59 Asia/Yekaterinburg.
Green captain report requires valid selected planned step IDs and cannot reuse already closed steps.
Blue captain report requires one or more valid related planned step IDs.
Red captain report does not require step selection and creates no weekly_report_steps.
Already closed planned steps cannot be closed again through captain report.
Final weekly report stores selected participant_id, team_id, selected status, report text, score, and week_number.
userSpecAcceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_captain_manual_report_flow.py::test_captain_green_manual_report_saves_report_steps_and_submitter asserts the full weekly report row.

userSpecAcceptanceCriteria.criterion: Final weekly report stores submitted_by_id as captain participant_id and submitted_by_role = captain.
userSpecAcceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_captain_manual_report_flow.py green and blue finalization tests assert submitted_by_id = C001 and submitted_by_role = captain.

userSpecAcceptanceCriteria.criterion: Captain manual report does not change insights and does not create a separate business fact outside weekly reports.
userSpecAcceptanceCriteria.evidence: CaptainService writes final facts through append_weekly_report and append_weekly_report_step only; no insight service or separate captain report table is used.

userSpecAcceptanceCriteria.criterion: Technical selected participant/status/steps/draft state stays in SQLite until final save.
Successful final save clears technical draft.
userSpecAcceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_captain_manual_report_flow.py green/blue/red finalization tests assert drafts.get_active_draft(captain.telegram_id) is None.

userSpecAcceptanceCriteria.criterion: Google Sheets or SQLite technical failures do not become final business facts and technical errors route only to admin error chat.
userSpecAcceptanceCriteria.evidence: Pre-deploy fake-boundary tests verify unknown/missing data technical errors route to error bot only, and rejected captain attempts create no final facts. Real Google Sheets/SQLite failure behavior requires live adapter fault handling or explicit fault-injection tests outside this local slice.

userSpecAcceptanceCriteria.criterion: Technical error details are not sent to participants, other captains, trackers, or Alexander Sitnikov.
userSpecAcceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_boundaries.py::test_technical_errors_route_only_to_error_bot; captain missing/unknown tests assert main bot receives safe copy while error details go to error bot.

userSpecAcceptanceCriteria.criterion: Feature does not add web form, PostgreSQL, Docker, Redis, Celery, web admin panel, participant-created steps, past-week editing, or late/yellow status.
userSpecAcceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_captain_boundaries.py::test_captain_flow_does_not_import_out_of_scope_runtime_dependencies; pyproject.toml has no runtime dependencies; no deploy/live integrations were added.

techSpecAcceptanceCriteria.criterion: User spec is approved before implementation tasks start.
techSpecAcceptanceCriteria.evidence: work/captain-flows/user-spec.md status = approved; decisions.md records approval commit 8a8f454.

techSpecAcceptanceCriteria.criterion: Captain-only flows require identified consenting user with role = captain.
techSpecAcceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_captain_team_flow.py covers unknown user, no consent, non-captain denial; CaptainService._resolve_captain gates manual report methods.

techSpecAcceptanceCriteria.criterion: Own-team list and participant selection are always scoped by captain team_id.
Forged selected participant IDs outside captain team are rejected server-side.
Dropped participants cannot receive captain manual reports.
Captain manual reports cannot be finalized after weekly deadline.
Green/blue captain reports require valid selected planned step IDs.
Red captain reports do not create weekly_report_steps.
Green closes selected planned steps; blue creates partial relations without closing them.
techSpecAcceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_captain_manual_report_flow.py green and blue finalization tests.

techSpecAcceptanceCriteria.criterion: Final weekly report rows store selected participant as report subject and captain as submitter.
techSpecAcceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_captain_manual_report_flow.py green and blue finalization tests assert participant_id = P001 and submitted_by_id = C001.

techSpecAcceptanceCriteria.criterion: SQLite stores only temporary captain draft state and is cleared after successful final save.
techSpecAcceptanceCriteria.evidence: tests/test_weekly_report_draft_repository.py captain draft tests; tests/test_captain_manual_report_flow.py finalization tests assert draft cleared.

techSpecAcceptanceCriteria.criterion: Technical errors route only through admin error chat.
techSpecAcceptanceCriteria.evidence: Verified for local unknown-user and missing-data paths via tests/test_captain_team_flow.py and tests/test_boundaries.py. Real adapter exceptions from live Google Sheets/SQLite require explicit fault injection or live integration checks.

techSpecAcceptanceCriteria.criterion: No out-of-scope infrastructure or features are added.

deferredToPostDeploy.criterion: US-AC16 / TS-AC13: real Google Sheets or SQLite adapter failures route technical details only to admin error chat and do not expose details to users.
deferredToPostDeploy.reason: Pre-deploy uses fake/local boundaries and does not exercise live Google Sheets or production SQLite failure modes.
deferredToPostDeploy.verificationCondition: A test/staging Telegram bot is wired to the live adapters with safe test data and controlled adapter failure or fault injection is available.

Verify the participant/captain sees only safe copy, admin error chat receives technical context without secrets, and no partial final weekly report is accepted as a completed business fact.

deferredToPostDeploy.criterion: Live Telegram UX: captain opens team and manual report flow through actual bot buttons/callbacks.
deferredToPostDeploy.reason: This feature slice is local service/fake-boundary based and does not add live Telegram SDK handlers or deploy.
deferredToPostDeploy.verificationCondition: Post-deploy test bot with captain and participant fixtures exists.
